breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between a 'gamma-centered' k-point grid and a 'half-shifted' Monkhorst-Pack mesh. These two settings are mutually exclusive. The ground truth resolves this by removing the conflicting 'half shift' instruction. The agent, however, repeated the error by requesting a 'gamma-centered... grid with... half shift'.
